description: in every 200 answer to an activation (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.8, from 1.9): the registration of appliance_id with device_pubkey is held under license_commitment at server_ts; a statement of state, not bound to one request; required with the licence statement to accept a rebinding (4.1)

server_key_id.description: the vendor countersigning key (format spec 10.7 key_id grammar)

server_signature.description: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs

license_commitment.description: the commitment the vendor holds this registration under at server_ts

statement_jcs.description: the statement in JCS form (RFC 8785); only these UTF-8 bytes are signed

title: Signed vendor statement: activation_receipt
